anomalies.observed: The EPD driver sheet shows C1 as 10 uF / 6.3 V, connected on the boost-converter input node (NET0013) together with C20 (0.1 uF/16 V) and the boost inductor L2.
anomalies.expected: The Pervasive Displays reference circuit for the G1 panel group (which the spec says this board implements) uses a 1 uF / 6.3 V capacitor in this position; the spec's component table lists the G1-specific value as 1 uF / 6.3 V.

evidence.quote: C1 (G1 group only): 1 uF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 uF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value

anomalies.impact: A 10x larger boost input capacitance changes the boost converter's startup and inrush behaviour and no longer matches the PDI reference values used to size the EPD power stage.

anomalies.observed: The EPD driver sheet contains two 10 uH inductors (L2 and L1) and only two SS2040FL diodes (U4, U5).
anomalies.expected: The PDI reference EPD driving circuit implemented here uses one 10 uH boost inductor and three SS2040FL rectifiers (U1/U2/U3 in the spec). A third rectifier position appears to be occupied by an inductor instead.

evidence.quote: L1 10uH (EPD_Driver sheet, vertical, next to C6/U4)
U1/U2/U3 | SS2040FL Schottky diodes (SOD-123FL) | EPD charge-pump/multiplier rectifiers ... L1 | 10 uH inductor | EPD boost-converter inductor

anomalies.impact: If a diode position is populated with an inductor, the EPD charge-pump/boost cannot rectify and generate the panel's VGH/VGL rails, so the display would not operate.

parsed.summary: The EPD driver sheet deviates from the PDI reference the spec says it implements: C1 is 10 uF/6.3 V instead of the specified 1 uF/6.3 V G1-group value, and the sheet carries two 10 uH inductors (L1, L2) with only two SS2040FL diodes instead of the reference's one inductor and three diodes.
